payload.claim: The module docstring says "A parent's `witness` gate already asked each declared wrong version once," but the `witness` gate only ever runs a criterion's declared mutant against its witness; wrong versions are never run by a gate at all. Per the `wrong_versions`/`wrong version` definitions and the originating backlog item b-9efbe2 ("The gates judge a child's witnesses and the child's declared mutants. Nothing runs a parent's recorded wrong versions..."), wrong versions are expressed and applied by REVIEW in a gate-only cell, which is exactly what this module's own PR context (SA-0402 runs the pairs from REVIEW) assumes. The docstring misattributes the mechanism to the `witness` gate, conflating two things CONTEXT.md deliberately keeps distinct.
